title: Seasonal High-Performance Computing & GPU Systems Architect
description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) is seeking a Seasonal HPC & GPU Systems Architect for our extreme computing research center in Thuwal. In this high-level role, you will lead research groups in analyzing performance bottlenecks of parallel scientific applications, implementing GPU-specific optimization models for weather and climate forecasting, and mentoring graduate research assistants. Strong expertise in systems programming using C/C++ is required.
requirements: Experience working as a Research Assistant, Systems Architect, or teaching computer systems performance.
Proven expertise writing custom C/C++ parallel computing modules and implementing GPU-specific optimizations.
Academic publication or research record in optimizing forecasting simulation engines or parallel algorithms.
Excellent academic writing and technical collaboration skills in English.
PhD or Master's degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or related high-performance computing track.
benefits: Fully covered housing and travel options
Access to KAUST Shaheen supercomputing clusters
